# Solarity AI

> Solarity AI builds AI-powered self-improvement apps for iOS and Android (Looks Max, IQ Max, Sleep Max, and Fitness Max) and three web apps for engineering, managing, and marketing mobile products (Engineering Max, Management Max, and Marketing Max).

Solarity AI LLC was founded by Ata Turhan in Irving, Texas, United States. The four mobile apps are listed on the App Store and Google Play. The three web apps run on the web today; mobile versions are planned. Contact: ata.turhan@solarityai.com (founder Ata Turhan).

## Mobile apps (iOS and Android)

- [Looks Max](https://solarityai.com/apps/looks-max/): Appearance & self-care. Personalized appearance insights, daily habits, and a place to follow your progress. On the App Store since 2026-06-23. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/looks-max-look-your-best/id6778990308), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.solarityai.onlylooksmax)
- [IQ Max](https://solarityai.com/apps/iq-max/): Cognitive practice. Focused cognitive exercises, adaptive difficulty, and a daily routine you control. On the App Store since 2026-09-11. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/iq-max-smarter-every-day/id6803826639), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.solarityai.iqmax)
- [Sleep Max](https://solarityai.com/apps/sleep-max/): Sleep & daily routines. A sleep diary, habit tracking, and coaching to support a more consistent routine. On the App Store since 2026-09-16. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sleep-max-rest-best/id6806709872), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.solarityai.sleepmax)
- [Fitness Max](https://solarityai.com/apps/fitness-max/): Fitness & nutrition. Meal insights, training logs, and AI coaching to help you follow your fitness routine. Listed in the app stores as Only Fitness. On the App Store since 2026-08-15. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/only-fitness-ai-coach/id6789095658), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.solarityai.onlyfitness)

## Web apps

- [Engineering Max](https://engineeringmax.solarityai.com/): App engineering, Web app · early access. Find and fix what keeps a mobile app out of the App Store.
- [Management Max](https://managementmax.solarityai.com/): Metrics for app portfolios, Web app · early access. Governed weekly metrics for mobile app companies.
- [Marketing Max](https://marketingmax.solarityai.com/): Short-form video marketing, Web app · early access. Your next Reel, made from one that already worked.
